item.title: Farmer in his 80s slapped with £40,000 fine after fly-tippers pile 200 tons of waste on his land
item.description: An elderly farmer has been slapped with a £40,000 fine after fly-tippers piled 200 tons of waste on his land.The Hertfordshire farmer, in his 80s, said the rubbish was dumped on his field near St Albans last summer.The farmer, who asked to remain anonymous, is now being held responsible for the clean-up after attempts to locate the culprit failed.He could also be criminally prosecuted if he cannot get rid of the rubbish.
